soal: I was born in Lagos, wrote 'Things Fall Apart', and my name means 'a child of the house'. Who am I?
I led Nigeria to independence in 1960 and became its first Governor-General. Who am I?
I painted the Mona Lisa and designed flying machines. Who am I?
I discovered penicillin by accident in 1928. Who am I?
I wrote 'Romeo and Juliet' and 'Hamlet'. Who am I?
I formulated the theory of general relativity. Who am I?
I was the first person to walk on the moon. Who am I?
I invented the telephone in 1876. Who am I?
I am the Nigerian musician called the 'King of Afrobeat'. Who am I?
I wrote 'Half of a Yellow Sun'. Who am I?
I discovered gravity after an apple, so the story goes. Who am I?
I led the Montgomery bus boycott and dreamed of equality. Who am I?
I coded the first compiler and popularised the term 'bug'. Who am I?
I created the World Wide Web while at CERN. Who am I?
I am the first woman to win a Nobel Prize, twice. Who am I?
I wrote the Nigerian national anthem's lyrics, 'Nigeria, We Hail Thee'. Who am I?
I conquered Europe and was exiled to Saint Helena. Who am I?
I painted 'The Starry Night'. Who am I?
I founded Apple with Steve Wozniak. Who am I?
I am known as the 'Lion of Judah' and ruled Ethiopia. Who am I?
